# M5 global + local selection (dev; generated by `scripts/m5_global_local.py`)

Scores per view = softmax over the 80 classes of logit_scale × cosine. Variant `aA_AGG_gGRIDS`: A·p_global + (1−A)·AGG over crops in GRIDS. `global` = M4 whole-image selector. Small pair = (image, class) whose objects in that image have median area < 32² px.
